major_issues.issue: 化合物 1–5 被错误归类为「5 种 ansatrienine 类」。原文明确写「Five ansamycins (ansatrienine A (1), naphthomycin B (2) and K (3), diastovaricin I (4) and II (5))」——这五种均为 ansamycins（安莎霉素大类），但仅 1 是 ansatrienine，2–3 是 naphthomycins，4–5 是 diastovaricins，归属错误，属化学分类事实错误。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF p.1，右栏 Introduction 第 1 段；Scheme 1 标题及其化合物编号
major_issues.correction: 改为「5 种安莎霉素（ansamycins）类，包括 ansatrienine A (1)、naphthomycin B (2) 与 K (3)、diastovaricin I (4) 与 II (5)」，避免统称为 ansatrienine。

minor_issues.issue: Scheme 1 裁剪图过宽，下部包含了 Scheme 2 的部分结构（化合物 17、18、19、20 的局部），虽然 Scheme 1 主体（1–16 与图注）完整，但不应混入下一页/相邻 scheme 的内容。
minor_issues.correction: 将 Scheme 1 裁剪框限定为 [0.05, 0.05, 0.97, 0.36] 左右，仅包含化合物 1–16 及 caption。

minor_issues.issue: Scheme 5 裁剪图过宽，左侧包含了 Scheme 4 的全部内容（37–55），Scheme 5 主体（56–67 与图注）完整但与 Scheme 4 混排。
minor_issues.correction: 将 Scheme 5 裁剪框限定为 [0.50, 0.05, 0.97, 0.55] 左右，仅包含化合物 56–67 及 caption。

verified_claims.claim: OSMAC 方法通过系统改变培养参数，单一菌株最多获得 20 种代谢物，最高产量 2.6 g L⁻¹
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 摘要（左侧灰框）
verified_claims.evidence: 「…were able to isolate up to 20 different metabolites in yields up to 2.6 g L⁻¹ from a single organism.」

verified_claims.claim: 6 株微生物分离得到 100 余种化合物，跨 25 种以上结构家族
verified_claims.evidence: 「Using the so-called OSMAC approach we were able to isolate more than 100 compounds belonging to more than 25 different structural classes from only 6 different microorganisms.」

verified_claims.claim: 添加 1 g L⁻¹ NaBr 使 hexacyclinic acid (19) 产量提高 13 倍
verified_claims.evidence: 「The production of 19 was increased 13-fold by the addition of 1 g L⁻¹ of NaBr to a standard cultivation medium.」

verified_claims.claim: Sphaeropsidales sp. F-24'707 螺双萘（cladospirones 及 palmarumycins）高达 2.6 g L⁻¹
verified_claims.evidence: 「…in yields of up to 2.6 g L⁻¹ (Scheme 4).」

verified_claims.claim: Ancymidole 反而使 cladospirone bisepoxide (37) 产量增加近三倍（非预期抑制）
verified_claims.evidence: 「…an almost threefold increase in the production of cladospirone bisepoxide was observed instead of the expected decrease.」

verified_claims.claim: mutolide (55) 产量达 70 mg L⁻¹，来自 UV 突变株
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.4 左下/右下正文
verified_claims.evidence: 「…could be isolated in yields of up to 70 mg L⁻¹; this turned out to be one of the rare fungal macrolides…It was named mutolide (55)」

verified_claims.claim: 高静水压 5–6 bar 使 S. parvulus Tü64 中 manumycin A (69) 减少，72、73、74–76 出现
verified_claims.evidence: 「With increasing hydrostatic pressure (5–6 bar) during the fermentation, the yield of manumycin A (69) decreased continuously whereas the new metabolites manumycin Ip (72) and Hp (73) and 64p A–C (74–76) are formed instead.」

verified_claims.claim: Streptomyces sp. A1 在燕麦麸培养基加 Celite (30 g L⁻¹) 使 81 产量提高 4 倍
verified_claims.evidence: 「A fourfold increase in the production of 81 could be observed when Celite (30 g L⁻¹) was added to the oat bran medium」

verified_claims.claim: Streptomyces Tü3634 通过喂入不同芳香/α,β-不饱和羧酸最多得到 30 种 acyl α-L-rhamnopyranoside
verified_claims.evidence: 「…up to 30 further acyl α-L-rhamnopyranosides can be obtained from different feeding experiments with aromatic, heteroaromatic, and α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acids.」

verified_claims.claim: 基因组大小：放线菌约 8 Mb，粘细菌约 11 Mb，真菌 > 30 Mb；每个菌株潜在可产 >10 种结构迥异次级代谢物
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.8 左栏正文末段
verified_claims.evidence: 「With a genome size of about 8 Mb in actinomycetes, up to 11 Mb in myxobacteria, and more than 30 Mb in fungi…might possess the genomic prerequisite for more than ten structurally distinct secondary metabolites.」
